summary: All 6 T11 sync-collection tests pass, covering initial snapshot, incremental sync, deletion representation, invalid token rejection, and pagination correctness. Full test suite passes with no failures.
important_context: Sync tokens are HMAC-signed opaque tokens (base64url(revision).base64url(hmac)) using the server's SecretKey
Deletions use RFC 6578 shape: D:status 404 as direct child of D:response
Pagination uses MAX_RESULTS=1000 bound; new token always advances past last returned revision
